name: The Heart of Texas Winter 2027
information: Speedcubing returns to Waco for the first time in nearly a year! ### You may register for any combination of up to 5 events. See the [Event Registration Limit tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheHeartofTexasWinter2027#84260-event-registration-limit) for more information. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC.
